notes.intent: The current LINE_CLICK_v16 army: light raiding. Three fast groups raid the enemy economy and build power (mexes, wind, nanos, labs, constructors) and run away from anything that out-trades them; one slow group (Lashers + Pounders, with rez bots) applies steady pressure and holds ground. Win by killing enemy eco/BP/commander, not by trade efficiency.
notes.control: Fast units (Shuriken, Wasp, Incisor, Raider): split into up to 3 attack groups, each sent at a different enemy target ranked by build power + eco value. Hit and retreat; do not fight into defences or a bigger army. Slow group (Lasher, Pounder): move together as one blob, Pounders in front, Lashers 2:1 behind them, staying with the rez bots. See click_army.lua and slow_front.lua.
notes.share: Army share set elsewhere (spine schedule/threat policies); about 20% floor from 3:00.

units.note: Wasp: air raiders, main fast group
Lasher: slow group support, 2 per Pounder
